10.interpretation: Secant speed from encoder positions; acceleration compares separated secants. Both measured and simulated encoders use the same estimator and timing windows. Bounds cover declared encoder quantization and transaction/sample-age windows, not encoder calibration error or unobserved motion. Crossings and settling describe the sampled estimates; they are not guaranteed instantaneous mechanical times or maximum motor capability. No time shift or automatic model promotion.

interpretation: Measured group response with serial per-axis windows. Peak secant speed is not a rated or continuous maximum. Group correlations alone do not identify a shared supply model; current remains uncalibrated raw telemetry.

scores.electrical: Servo voltage in 0.1 V counts; current remains uncalibrated raw counts. Measured amps, watts and battery validation unavailable.
scores.target_comparison: Encoder observation versus previous applied discrete setpoint; target changes are held between FPGA batches. Position is internal encoder feedback, not an independent output shaft measurement.
